headline: U.S. Begins $1.3 Billion Retirement Process for First Nuclear Aircraft Carrier
summary: The United States Navy has begun the final journey of the USS Enterprise, the world's first nuclear-powered aircraft carrier, marking the end of a warship whose retirement and dismantling programme cost over $1.3 billion.
why: Large-scale military decommissioning projects involve substantial multi-billion-dollar outlays for defense contractors and specialized engineering services.
